question: A consultant set account-wide instructions two years ago describing a role they no longer hold, and answers now carry the wrong framing. What is the most appropriate action?
options: A) Mention the correct role at the start of each conversation and accept the extra step as normal.
B) Update the account-wide instructions so they describe the consultant's current role and the work they do now.
C) Create a brand-new account so that the outdated preferences are all left behind with the previous configuration.
D) Add a line to every project's instructions telling Claude to disregard the account-wide instructions.
correct_answers: B) Update the account-wide instructions so they describe the consultant's current role and the work they do now.
explanations: Repeating a correction forever is the manual overhead durable configuration exists to remove.
Correct. Personal configuration needs the same periodic refresh as any other durable direction.
Abandoning an account to escape a stale setting loses all the history and other configuration with it.
This is a workaround that leaves the outdated configuration in place for all work outside projects.
